# Font Awesome Free 6.7.2 — Masar UI icons

Official source: https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/tree/6.7.2

The local SVG sprite contains only Free icons used by Masar. Original paths and
view boxes come from metadata/icons.json. Solid icons represent actions and
content; brands identify professional and social links. Favorites use regular
and solid hearts. Glyphs inherit currentColor and the existing SVG layout rules.

Use courses/icon.html for semantic dashboard names, or an SVG use reference to
this sprite. Themes and alerts read the sprite URL from data-icon-sprite on the
HTML element. No external CDN, Kit, webfont, or runtime DOM replacement is used.

The Masar logo, course images, decorative journey illustration, native controls,
and Django's bundled admin assets are preserved.

Icons are licensed CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE.txt; keep the attribution when updating.
circle-check.svg and minus.svg use the same Free paths for checkbox CSS assets.
